title: Maintenance Share for Guest Unit Heating and Cooling under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons
content:
**Rule.** For a guest unit heating or cooling system under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons, the lowest amount on a work authorization is paid at a maintenance share that depends on the customer's HVAC maintenance records under the HVAC Maintenance Agreements, namely the date of the latest completed tune-up visit, measured in whole months before the authorization date:

| Latest completed tune-up visit | Maintenance share |
|---|---|
| Dated less than 12 whole months before the authorization date | In full |
| Dated 12 or more, but fewer than 24, whole months before | 0.90 (90 percent) |
| No completed tune-up dated less than 24 whole months before (including no completed tune-up at all) | 0.80 (80 percent) |

The amount paid at a share is the lowest amount multiplied by the share, rounded to the cent. A component of any other kind is paid in full. Only tune-up visits recorded as completed count.

## Boundary points (whole months from the latest completed tune-up to the authorization date)

| Whole months | Share |
|---|---|
| 11 | In full |
| 12 | 0.90 |
| 23 | 0.90 |
| 24 | 0.80 |

**Hypothetical case.** A guest unit cooling system with a lowest amount of USD 1,250.00 and a latest completed tune-up 15 whole months earlier: USD 1,250.00 at 0.90 is USD 1,125.00.
